title: Leveraging LLMs for User Stories in AI Systems: UStAI Dataset
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark measures the quality of Large Language Model (LLM)-generated user stories for AI systems based on the Quality User Story (QUS) framework, and the presence of non-functional requirements (NFRs) and general ethical principles.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its findings focus on the quality of user stories generated by different LLMs for AI systems, concluding that Gemini 1.5 Flash produced higher quality stories with a better grasp of ethical principles compared to Llama 3.1 70b and ChatGPT (o1-mini).
